exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.precautions: Entire lower back gently pressed into floor - no gap;Only opposite arm+leg move - torso completely still;Move very slowly - 3 seconds out, 3 back;Breathe out slowly as you reach
exercises.cues: Low back gently pressed to floor;Move opposite arm and leg slowly;Breathe out as you reach

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.precautions: Body one straight line - hips not sagging or high;Elbows under shoulders, forearms flat;Squeeze glutes and thighs hard the whole time;Head neutral - look at floor, breathe steadily
exercises.cues: Body in one straight line;Squeeze glutes and core;Breathe steadily, hips level

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.precautions: Kneel tall facing cable, hips stay back and still;Rope by your ears - arms locked, they never pull;Curl ribs toward pelvis - spine rounds like a C;Lower back stays put - only your torso curls
exercises.cues: Kneel, rope behind head;Curl down ribs-to-pelvis;Rise slowly to tall kneeling

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.precautions: Sit tall, knees bent, heels lightly on floor;Lean back slightly with a LONG straight back - never rounded;Rotate from ribs - shoulders turn, hips stay still;Move slowly - momentum does no work here
exercises.cues: Sit tall, lean back a little;Turn shoulders side to side;Tap floor lightly each side

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.precautions: Plank position - body one straight line head-to-heels;Hands directly under shoulders, arms straight;Hips stay level - no bouncing up and down;Knees drive toward chest, feet land softly
exercises.cues: Start in strong plank;Drive knees in alternately;Keep hips low and steady

exercises.name: Torso Rotation Machine
exercises.precautions: Sit with knees secured against the pads;Grip the handles and rotate by twisting from your waist - not by pulling with your arms;Move slowly and return with control;Keep the range comfortable - stop before any pinch in your lower back
exercises.cues: Twist from your waist, not arms;Rotate slowly to each side;Control the return

exercises.name: Standing Knee Raises
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, chair or wall within reach for balance;Lift one knee to hip height - no higher needed;Do not lean back as the knee rises;Lower the foot softly before switching sides
exercises.cues: Stand tall, brace your middle;Lift knee, lower slowly;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Standing Cross-Body Crunch
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, fingertips lightly behind your ears - do not pull your neck;Turn from your waist as elbow meets opposite knee;Lift the knee to meet the elbow, not the other way;Move slowly - no yanking or bouncing
exercises.cues: Elbow to opposite knee;Twist from the waist;Alternate sides slowly

exercises.name: Spider Climbers
exercises.precautions: Start in a strong high plank - body one straight line;Bring the foot outside the same-side hand, knee wide;Hips stay level - no rocking side to side;Move under control, speed comes second
exercises.cues: Plank tall;Step foot outside hand;Alternate sides smoothly

exercises.name: Cross Climbers
exercises.precautions: High plank - hands under shoulders, body straight;Drive each knee toward the OPPOSITE elbow;Hips stay level, no bouncing;Twist comes from the waist, not the shoulders
exercises.cues: Plank strong;Knee to opposite elbow;Alternate with control

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.precautions: Drive knees to hip height, alternating fast;Stay tall - do not lean back;Land on the balls of your feet, light and quick;Pump the opposite arm with each knee
exercises.cues: Knees up to hip height;Stay tall, arms pumping;Light fast feet

exercises.name: Chakki Chalanasana (Seated Churning)
exercises.precautions: Sit with legs wide, arms extended in front, fingers interlocked;Circle the torso in big smooth rounds, like churning;Keep the movement flowing, not forced;Switch direction halfway
exercises.cues: Legs wide, arms forward;Circle the torso smoothly;Reverse halfway

exercises.name: Half Crunch
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat; Curl your shoulders just off the floor - a short range;Hands lightly by your head, never pull the neck;Breathe out as you curl up
exercises.cues: Shoulders just lift;Short, controlled curls;Exhale on the way up

exercises.name: Knee Claps
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, lift one knee toward your chest;Clap hands under the lifted thigh;Alternate quickly but under control;Stay upright - bring the knee up, don't fold down
exercises.cues: Knee up, clap under thigh;Alternate sides;Stay tall

exercises.name: Standing Side Bend
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, feet hip-width;Slide one hand down the thigh as you bend sideways;Keep hips and chest facing forward - bend, don't twist;Rise back to centre before switching sides
exercises.cues: Bend sideways, hand slides down;Face forward throughout;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Standing Torso Twist
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, hands clasped at chest height;Rotate shoulders and ribs side to side;Hips stay facing forward - twist from the waist up;Move smoothly, no jerking
exercises.cues: Hips stay put;Twist from the waist;Smooth side to side

exercises.name: Ball Slam
exercises.precautions: Use a soft/dead medicine ball that does not bounce back; Lift the ball overhead, rise on toes;Slam it down by folding from the hips and core;Squat to pick it up with a flat back
exercises.cues: Ball overhead, up tall;Slam down hard;Squat to retrieve

exercises.name: Side Plank Dip
exercises.precautions: Side plank on your forearm, body one straight line;Lower the hip a few inches, then lift back up;Keep the chest open, not rolled forward;Stacked feet or staggered - whichever keeps you steady
exercises.cues: Straight line on forearm;Dip hip, lift back;Chest stays open

exercises.name: Crunch Extension
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, knees bent up;Crunch up while reaching arms long, then extend back down slowly;Keep the lower back gently pressed down at the bottom;Never yank the neck
exercises.cues: Crunch and reach long;Extend back slowly;Low back stays down

exercises.name: Oblique Crunches
exercises.precautions: Stand (or sit) tall, fingertips lightly behind your ears;Crunch sideways, bringing ribs toward the hip on the same side;Do not pull your neck or twist forward;Alternate sides with control
exercises.cues: Crunch ribs to hip, same side;Stay facing forward;Alternate slowly

exercises.name: Seated Alternating Toe Touches
exercises.precautions: Sit tall on a sturdy chair, legs extended or bent;Reach one hand toward the opposite foot;Keep the reach gentle - hinge from the hips, back long;Alternate sides smoothly
exercises.cues: Sit tall;Reach to the opposite foot;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Seated Leg Raises
exercises.precautions: Sit on the floor or a bench, hands beside your hips for support;Lean back slightly with a long straight back;Raise both legs together a few inches, then lower slowly;Keep the lower back from rounding hard
exercises.cues: Sit tall, lean back a little;Raise legs together;Lower slowly

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet anchored or heavy dumbbells on them;Curl all the way up until your torso is upright;Lower back down slowly, one vertebra at a time;Never yank with your arms or neck
exercises.cues: Curl all the way up tall;Lower slowly;Steady breathing

exercises.name: Overhead March
exercises.precautions: Hold one light dumbbell overhead, arm locked, ribs down;March, driving each knee toward the opposite elbow;Stay tall - do not lean away from the weight;Keep the overhead arm still the whole time
exercises.cues: Weight locked overhead;March knees up tall;Ribs stay down

exercises.name: Halo to Woodchop
exercises.precautions: Circle one dumbbell around your head (the halo), then chop it diagonally down across your body;Pivot the back foot as you chop;Keep the motion controlled - never swing near your head;Complete all reps one direction, then switch
exercises.cues: Circle the head, chop across;Pivot the back foot;Smooth and controlled

exercises.name: Uppercut Punches
exercises.precautions: Light dumbbells at chin height, athletic stance;Punch upward alternately, rotating through the waist;Keep the non-punching hand guarding your chin;Stay light on your feet, breathe out on each punch
exercises.cues: Punch up, twist from the waist;Hands stay at the chin;Light quick feet

exercises.name: Double Crunch
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, knees bent up over your hips;Curl your shoulders up AND draw knees in at the same time;Lower both slowly without letting feet touch down;Keep the lower back gently pressed down
exercises.cues: Shoulders and knees curl together;Lower slowly;Back stays down

exercises.name: Crunch Kicks
exercises.precautions: Sit in a crunch position, leaning back on your forearms or hands;Kick legs out alternately while holding the crunch;Keep your chest lifted and back long;Never let the lower back sag hard
exercises.cues: Hold the crunch position;Kick legs alternately;Chest stays lifted

exercises.name: Heel Touches
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your hips;Crunch up slightly and reach one hand to the same-side heel;Alternate sides in a steady rhythm;Keep shoulders off the floor the whole time
exercises.cues: Reach hand to same-side heel;Alternate sides;Shoulders stay lifted

exercises.name: Plank Jumps
exercises.precautions: From a high plank, jump both feet in toward your hands and back out;Keep hips from bouncing high;Land soft and quiet;Step in and out instead if jumping is too much
exercises.cues: Plank tall;Jump feet in and out;Hips stay level

exercises.name: Plank Jump Kick Backs
exercises.precautions: From plank, jump feet in, then kick both legs back out to plank;Keep the middle braced so the back never sags;Small fast jumps - control over height;Wrist break: drop to forearms between reps if needed
exercises.cues: Jump in, kick back out;Brace the middle;Quick controlled rhythm

exercises.name: Plank Hip Dips
exercises.precautions: Forearm plank, body one straight line;Rotate your hips to dip one side toward the floor, then the other;Keep shoulders level while the hips turn;Move slowly - range is small
exercises.cues: Forearm plank strong;Dip hips side to side;Shoulders stay level

exercises.name: Plank Knee Touches
exercises.precautions: From a high plank, bend one knee down to touch the floor;Return and alternate;Hips stay level, no rocking;Keep arms straight and strong
exercises.cues: Plank tall;Touch knee down lightly;Alternate, hips still

exercises.name: Plank Reach Outs
exercises.precautions: High plank; reach one arm straight out in front of you;Keep hips perfectly level - no tipping toward the lifted side;Alternate arms slowly
exercises.cues: Reach one arm long;Hips dead level;Alternate slowly

exercises.name: Plank Ball Pass
exercises.precautions: Forearm plank with a medicine ball under your chest;Pass the ball from one hand to the other under your torso;Hips stay level the whole time;Use a ball that will not roll away fast
exercises.cues: Forearm plank steady;Pass the ball hand to hand;Hips stay level

exercises.name: Plank Pull-Through
exercises.precautions: High plank (feet elevated in the source version), kettlebell beside one hand;Reach under your body and drag the kettlebell to the other side;Hips stay square - the drag is slow and heavy, never a swing;Alternate sides each pass
exercises.cues: Plank strong;Drag the weight across slowly;Hips stay square

exercises.name: Froggers
exercises.precautions: From plank, jump both feet wide outside your hands into a frog squat;Jump straight back to plank;Keep your chest up in the frog position;Step in and out to scale it down
exercises.cues: Jump feet wide outside hands;Sit like a frog, chest up;Jump back to plank

exercises.name: Lizard Hops
exercises.precautions: From plank, hop one foot outside the same-side hand (lizard position);Hop-switch sides in rhythm;Hips stay as level as the move allows;Slow down rather than letting form collapse
exercises.cues: Foot hops outside the hand;Switch sides in rhythm;Stay controlled

exercises.name: Plank Jacks
exercises.precautions: High plank; jump feet wide and together like a horizontal jumping jack;Hips stay level - no bouncing up and down;Step feet out and in to scale down
exercises.cues: Plank strong;Feet jump wide and together;Hips stay level

exercises.name: KB Toe Touches
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back holding a light kettlebell above your chest, legs up;Curl up and reach the kettlebell toward your toes;Lower slowly - shoulders, then back;Keep the weight light until the pattern is clean
exercises.cues: Legs up, weight over chest;Reach toward your toes;Lower slowly

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, fingertips lightly behind your ears;Bring one elbow to the opposite knee while the other leg extends;Rotate from the ribs - never pull your neck;Slow down if it turns into flailing
exercises.cues: Elbow to opposite knee;Other leg reaches long;Rotate from the ribs

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, hands under your hips;Legs long, kick up and down in small quick flutters;Keep your lower back pressed into the floor;Raise the legs higher if your back arches
exercises.cues: Low back pressed down;Small quick kicks;Breathe steadily

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.precautions: Forearm down, elbow under shoulder;Body one straight line from head to heels;Hips stacked - do not roll forward or back;Drop the bottom knee for support if you shake hard
exercises.cues: Straight line, hips stacked;Chest open;Breathe steadily

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raises
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, hands under your hips;Raise both legs up together, keeping them straight-ish;Lower slowly - stop before your lower back arches off the floor;Never let the feet slam down
exercises.cues: Legs rise together;Lower slowly;Back stays down

exercises.name: In & Outs
exercises.precautions: Sit leaning back on your hands, legs floating;Draw knees in to your chest, then extend legs long;Keep your chest lifted and back long - never rounded hard;Move in a steady rhythm
exercises.cues: Knees in, legs extend long;Chest stays lifted;Steady rhythm

exercises.name: Star Crunch
exercises.precautions: Lie spread out like a star, arms and legs wide;Curl up and bring one hand to the opposite foot;Lower back to the star shape between reps;Alternate sides, never yank your neck
exercises.cues: Spread out like a star;Hand to opposite foot;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Seated Leg Kicks
exercises.precautions: Sit tall leaning back slightly, hands behind you for support;Kick legs alternately in the air, low and quick;Keep the torso still - only the legs move;Lower back stays long, not rounded
exercises.cues: Sit tall, lean back a little;Quick alternating kicks;Torso stays still

exercises.name: Body Kicks (Muay Thai Roundhouse)
exercises.precautions: Light bouncing stance, hands up guarding;Pivot the standing foot and swing the shin across at waist height;Strike with the shin, not the foot;Re-chamber and return to stance each kick
exercises.cues: Pivot, swing the shin across;Hands stay up;Back to stance each rep

exercises.name: Switch Knees (Muay Thai)
exercises.precautions: Small hop to switch your stance feet;As you land, drive the new front knee straight up;Hands stay guarding your face;Stay light - this is fast feet plus a knee, not a jump squat
exercises.cues: Switch feet quickly;Drive the knee up;Hands stay up

exercises.name: Push-Up Toe Touch
exercises.precautions: Do a push-up, then pike your hips up and touch one hand to the opposite foot;Return to plank before the next push-up;Keep each half clean - no collapsing between parts;Slow down if the pike turns sloppy
exercises.cues: Push-up, pike, touch opposite foot;Back to plank;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Kneeling Side Bends
exercises.precautions: Kneel tall, one hand on the floor beside you for support if needed;Bend sideways over the supporting side, free arm reaching overhead;Keep hips square and still;Alternate sides slowly
exercises.cues: Kneel tall;Bend over the support hand;Free arm reaches long

exercises.name: Squat + Twist High Knee
exercises.precautions: Squat with light dumbbells at your shoulders or chest;As you stand, twist and drive one knee up across your body;Keep the twist in the waist, hips mostly forward;Alternate knees each rep
exercises.cues: Squat;Stand, twist, knee up;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Squat to Side Crunch
exercises.precautions: Squat down fully;As you stand, lift one knee out to the side and crunch your elbow toward it;Keep the crunch sideways, not forward;Alternate sides each squat
exercises.cues: Squat;Stand into a side crunch;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Knee Drive with Bicep Curl
exercises.precautions: Stand tall with light dumbbells;Drive one knee up while curling both dumbbells;Alternate knees in rhythm;Keep the torso tall - no leaning back
exercises.cues: Knee up, curl together;Alternate sides;Stay tall

exercises.name: Knee Drive with Overhead Press
exercises.precautions: Light dumbbells at shoulder height;Drive one knee up while pressing both weights overhead;Brace your middle so the press never arches your back;Alternate knees each rep
exercises.cues: Knee up, press overhead;Brace, no back arch;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Floor Wipers
exercises.precautions: Lower back stays pressed to the floor throughout;Swing legs only as far as you can without your back arching;Move slowly - rushing turns it into momentum;Stop if your lower back feels pinched
exercises.cues: Legs up, arms out wide for balance;Lower your legs side to side like wipers;Keep your back glued down

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
exercises.precautions: Hang from a secure bar with a strong grip;Raise your legs with control - no swinging;Lower all the way down slowly;Stop if your grip or shoulders feel unsafe
exercises.cues: Hang tall, brace your core;Curl your knees or legs up;Lower slowly, no swing

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.precautions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on;Ribs down, glutes tight, hips square;Press straight out - do not let the band rotate you;Inspect the band for nicks before every set
exercises.cues: Hold the band at your chest;Press straight ahead;Resist the twist, return slowly

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.precautions: Lower back stays on the floor - lift your hips, not just your knees;Move slowly, no swinging momentum;Exhale as you curl your pelvis up;Stop if your neck or lower back strains
exercises.cues: Knees bent over your hips;Curl your pelvis off the floor;Lower slowly, repeat

exercises.name: Spider-Man Steps
exercises.precautions: From a plank, step your foot outside the same-side hand;Hips stay low and level - no sagging;Shoulders stay over your wrists;Move slowly - this is a mobility drill
exercises.cues: Plank tall and tight;Step your foot outside your hand;Return, alternate sides

stretches.name: High Plank to Squat Hold
stretches.precautions: From plank, jump or step both feet outside your hands;Sit into a deep squat hold, chest up, heels down;Return to plank with a flat back;Step instead of jump if wrists or knees prefer it
stretches.cues: Plank, hop feet wide;Sit into the squat, chest tall;Back to plank, repeat

stretches.name: Bear Hold Shoulder Tap
stretches.precautions: All fours, then lift knees just off the floor;Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder;Hips stay perfectly level - no rocking;Knees lower if your wrists need a break
stretches.cues: Knees hovering;Tap opposite shoulder;Hips dead still

stretches.name: Hollow Hold
stretches.precautions: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor;Arms overhead, legs extended low - body makes a banana shape;If your back lifts off the floor, bend the knees or raise the legs higher;Breathe in short steady breaths
stretches.cues: Low back pressed down;Arms and legs long;Small banana shape

stretches.name: Reverse Plank Hold
stretches.precautions: Sit facing up, hands behind you, fingers forward;Lift hips until your body is one line from head to heels;Chest open, neck neutral;Lower and rest if your shoulders complain
stretches.cues: Lift hips to a straight line;Chest open;Breathe steadily
